findings.fact: Six available support packs against eight required; two held items do not count as available.
findings.action: Correct the packet to six available and keep the two-item gap visible. Route the shortage for an owner decision; do not invent replacement stock.

findings.fact: CASE-B has documentation revision B; the control card requires revision C. The packet claims C for both cases.
findings.action: Record the version mismatch and route it to the documentation lead. Do not assume the case has been updated.

findings.fact: H01 has no accountable issue owner. An intake entry is not an accepted ownership handoff.
findings.action: Propose a named accountable role, due date and acceptance request. Keep proposed assignment distinct from recorded acceptance.

findings.fact: H02 has a named owner and recorded acceptance but no due date.
findings.action: Request and record an agreed follow-up date; the learner may propose one but may not call it accepted without evidence.

findings.fact: The final packet recommends READY despite the later source records and unresolved handoff controls.
findings.action: Recommend HOLD FOR REVIEW under the exercise rule and send the exception summary to the Demo event lead. Do not claim event authorization.

rubric.full_credit: Cites document IDs and the expected and observed values for all material findings.
States six available against eight required and excludes the two held items from available stock.
Identifies CASE-B revision B versus required C and does not claim an unobserved update.
Identifies H01 missing owner; distinguishes a proposed owner from accepted ownership.
Identifies H02 missing due date; records a proposed follow-up without inventing agreement.
Recommends HOLD FOR REVIEW, explains why and names the Demo event lead as decision authority.
Provides a concise issue, impact, source, next action, proposed owner/date and acceptance request.
Links the AAR, process correction and a revised learner task with an observable standard.
Keeps unresolved shortages and revision gaps open; does not invent closure, acceptance or qualification.
